0.0: #b#h0##k! It's been a long time! How's the journey going for you? It gives me a great sense of pride to see you all grown up like this! I actually want to give you a test to see how powerful you've become. Humor me?

yes.0: Alright, I want you to gather #b80 #t04000024#s#k and #b100 #t04000020#s#k. If you can do it, I'll acknowledge you as a formidable adventurer.

no.0: You don't seem confident in your abilities. Must be a bad day. When you're feeling better, talk to me.

1.0: Wow, amazing! I can't believe you're done already! You have indeed become much more powerful than even I anticipated.

yes.0: Did you receive the money I gave you? It should be enough for you to travel to a few new places. Best of luck to you.

item.0: Hmmm...you're still short on those items? Did I overestimate your abilities? Nah. Get me #b80 #t04000024#s#k and #b100 #t04000020#s#k. I know you can do this with ease.
